_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-19 slate (Taipei 09-20). Nineteenth slate of the prospective test. Ten of the fifteen games on the US card. One reading conflict, and it is the same matchup that conflicted yesterday, pointing the other way: Twins at Angels is corrected to the Angels. Yesterday I read the handicap on the Angels' row and the market said Minnesota; today I read it on Minnesota's row and the market says the Angels, at 0.5046 with eight of eleven books above even. My row reading has now been wrong on this one pairing two days running in opposite directions, which is what an unreliable input looks like from close up. The market is thin here and the starters changed between the two games, so the flip itself is unremarkable; what is not unremarkable is that my reading flipped too and landed wrong both times. Minnesota is recorded as the alternative reading. The board's own moneyline column appears in six games and agrees with the market in all six; the other three lacking it -- Phillies at Mets, Royals at Pirates, Braves at Astros -- all match my reading on the market alone. Handicaps flat at 0.950, totals flat at 0.940, no split prices.
